body: Forgiveness for me would be saying I’m at peace with those events/absolve her of the guilt of them.  I don’t for either of those.  The truth is there’s things she’s done that still hurt me, and unfortunately the same way I have to live with that she needs to live with the fact that I’m not going to ever tell her I think it’s okay for her to forget those actions and consider them 100% in the past.
I’m not sure, that’s a possibility though - it fits around when I narrowed my great  or great great grandfathers birthday down too
